subject: Performance charter: metrics, owners, next steps
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Alex Veridian <alex@veridian.ai>, Procurement <procurement@veridian.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Jun 2025 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Performance charter: metrics, owners, next steps

Alex — thanks for the time on the call today. Quick recap and the concrete next steps so we all have alignment before the PoC kickoff.

Key objectives we agreed on (candidate metrics to confirm):
- Latency: 95p response latency target for 256-token prompts <= 120ms
- Throughput: baseline throughput of 60 QPS for batched inference (target 95% of test window)
- Cost: target cost per 1k tokens <= $0.75 (during steady-state with recommended batching/quantization)
- Quality: F1 on labeled intent dataset >= 0.88 and human-rated relevance >= 4/5 on sampled prompts

Proposed ownership (please confirm or correct):
- Redwood: runtime configuration, model variant mapping, batching and cache setup (Rishi)
- Veridian: workload samples, labeled intents, acceptance prompt set, and procurement signoff (Alex + Procurement)
- CS / Success: run regular check-ins, collect human-review samples, and own final acceptance gating (Marissa)

Immediate next steps (this week):
1) Alex: share sample traffic (JSON) and the labeled intent CSV — aim EOD Wednesday (attached sample format).
2) Rishi: prepare the trial-metrics-template.xlsx with measured baselines on our infra and a suggested test window — will share by Thursday.
3) Marissa: schedule weekly 30-min checkpoints for the trial and draft the acceptance checklist.

Please reply to confirm the owners and the targets above or propose edits. Once we have confirmation, we will circulate a short statement-of-performance and lock the kickoff date.

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt | Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0191

Attachment: sample-requests.json (format example for workload samples)
From: Alex Veridian <alex@veridian.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@veridian.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 09:28:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Performance charter: metrics, owners, next steps

Thanks Hannah — this lines up well with our internal goals. A couple of clarifications from our side:
- Latency: our internal consumer SLA is 150ms at 95p, but we can relax that to 120ms for the PoC provided cost/quality tradeoffs are acceptable.
- Throughput: 60 QPS is fine as a baseline; can we include a 95th percentile run at peak (10-minute sustained burst) as an additional check?
- Cost: procurement will need a rough TCO projection for a 3-month pilot — is your $0.75/1k tokens a steady-state estimate or including burst scenarios?

We will send the labeled intent set and a 48-hour sample of traffic by Wednesday EOD — attaching a link to our internal doc describing the intents. Also adding our procurement lead on the thread for terms discussions.

On owners: confirmed — Alex (product), Procurement (procurement), Redwood (runtime), CS (success).

Alex Veridian
Head of Product, Veridian AI
alex@veridian.ai | +1 212-555-0177

Subject: Re: Performance charter: metrics, owners, next steps

Alex, Hannah — thanks. Quick technical notes and an ask so we can prepare an empirical baseline before the kickoff: 

Technical probes we'll run on the sample window you send:
- 256-token 95p latency and P50 across single-request and batched modes
- Sustained burst test: 10-minute window with target concurrency to approximate 10x normal QPS
- Throughput sweep: measure tokens/sec and model compute consumption across batch sizes 1, 8, 16, 32
- Cost estimate: run inference with quantized and non-quantized variants to produce $/1k token table

Ask: please include a schema for error classification (what counts as an automatic failure vs. a human-review) and a short set of 20 golden prompts for manual review. That speeds up our human-rated quality checks.

I'll upload the filled trial-metrics-template.xlsx to the shared link once the baseline runs complete — target Friday midday (PDT).

Thanks — Rishi
Rishi Malhotra | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

Action items consolidated:
- Alex: deliver labeled intents + 48h traffic sample + golden prompts (Wed EOD)

I'll keep procurement updated on any timing shifts. Looking forward to kickoff.
